What is a Distributed system

A particular bank has branches in major towns of the Kenya i.e. Nairobi, Nakuru, Eldoret, Kisumu, Kakamega and Mombasa. Each branch uses a computer for the management of its information, but the branches are not currently linked together. The bank wants to integrate the branches (nodes) using a computer network and it has two options - to design either; a centralized system or a distributed system. You are required to advice the company's IT director (who is not conversant with distributed systems) about the following; I. Explain to director three benefits that the users will be expected to observe when the company implements a distributed system as compared to a centralized system II. Describe to him two reasons as to why they should implement each of the following techniques in the system. i. Replication ii. Caching
Describe two example of a distributed system you know. Show how it satisfies the main requirements of a well-designed distributed system.
